title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Explore the streets and districts surrounding Carroll College, from the historic downtown gulch to the essential commercial corridors of Helena.

cards.title: Historic Walking Mall
cards.subtitle: Last Chance Gulch
cards.notes: Walk the pedestrian-only blocks of the historic downtown to visit local shops and the iconic 'Guardian of the Gulch' fire tower.
cards.short_summary: A historic pedestrian mall in downtown Helena featuring local retail and landmarks.
cards.evidence_claim: The Carroll campus is located just a few blocks from downtown Helena, which includes the historic Last Chance Gulch area.
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 for walking; business hours vary by shop.

cards.title: The Campus Gateway
cards.subtitle: North Benton Avenue
cards.notes: Follow this primary artery bordering the west side of campus to reach O'Connell Hall and the main visitor parking areas.
cards.short_summary: The main thoroughfare bordering Carroll College's western edge and primary campus entrance.
cards.evidence_claim: O'Connell Hall and visitor parking are located on Benton Ave on the west side of campus.
cards.access_notes: Public street accessible at all times.

cards.title: Essential Retail Hub
cards.subtitle: Euclid Avenue
cards.notes: Visit this commercial corridor just one block from campus for grocery shopping, pharmacy needs, and quick dining options.
cards.short_summary: A major commercial street located one block from Carroll College providing essential services.
cards.evidence_claim: The Carroll campus is located just one block from a shopping area, which corresponds to the Euclid Avenue corridor.
cards.access_notes: Public commercial street; individual business hours vary.

cards.title: Historic Residential Link
cards.subtitle: Lawrence Street
cards.notes: Walk this street to see historic Helena architecture while transitioning between the campus and the downtown district.
cards.short_summary: A residential street connecting the Carroll College area to the historic downtown core.
cards.evidence_claim: Lawrence Street serves as a primary residential connector between the college and the downtown Helena area.

cards.title: Cultural Institution Row
cards.subtitle: Park Avenue
cards.notes: Access the Holter Museum of Art and the Helena Civic Center along this street, which borders the downtown walking mall.
cards.short_summary: A downtown street home to major cultural venues like the Holter Museum of Art.
cards.evidence_claim: The Holter Museum of Art is a notable cultural destination for students located in the downtown area.
cards.source_title: Top Free and Affordable Activities for Carroll College Students

cards.title: Oldest Helena Block
cards.subtitle: Reeder's Alley
cards.notes: Explore the oldest intact piece of early Helena, featuring brick miners' dwellings and historic interpretive displays.
cards.short_summary: A preserved historic district at the south end of downtown Helena.
cards.evidence_claim: Reeder's Alley is a picturesque historic site that provides a unique glimpse into Helena's past for students.
cards.source_title: Top Free and Affordable Activities for Carroll College Students
cards.access_notes: Outdoor areas open to the public; visitor center hours vary.

cards.title: Student Housing Hub
cards.subtitle: East Broadway Street
cards.notes: Walk this corridor to reach off-campus student apartment complexes located just east of the main downtown area.
cards.short_summary: A street known for off-campus student housing options near the college.
cards.evidence_claim: Carroll College student apartments are located on East Broadway Street.
cards.source_title: Apartments For Rent Near Carroll College

cards.title: Downtown Dining Link
cards.subtitle: Sixth Avenue
cards.notes: Navigate this street to find local eateries and coffee shops like The General Mercantile, a popular student study spot.
cards.short_summary: A downtown street connecting various local businesses and student-friendly cafes.
cards.evidence_claim: The General Mercantile, a favorite student study spot, is located in the downtown area accessible via Sixth Avenue.
cards.source_title: The Best Carroll College Study Spots

cards.title: Civic and Local Business Block
cards.subtitle: Fuller Avenue
cards.notes: Find local government offices and small businesses along this street, which runs parallel to the main walking mall.
cards.short_summary: A downtown street hosting local businesses and civic services near the college.
cards.evidence_claim: Fuller Avenue is part of the downtown Helena grid frequently used by students for local services.

cards.title: Historic District Corridor
cards.subtitle: Placer Avenue
cards.notes: Stroll through this historic residential area to see well-preserved 19th-century homes within walking distance of campus.
cards.short_summary: A street in Helena's historic district featuring significant local architecture.
cards.evidence_claim: Placer Avenue is located within the historic residential orbit of Carroll College.
